Subject: a generously sized ivory browser search-results panel, viewed nearly front-on with just a gentle three-quarter tilt and a little physical thickness. A simple search field at top, two muted placeholder results below, and one large highlighted result in the middle with a warm amber inset background, a deep navy title bar, and two shorter muted description bars. A beautifully modeled large deep-navy mouse pointer overlaps and points directly at the highlighted result; three tiny amber click rays at the pointer tip convey a click. The highlighted result is the unmistakable focal point.
Style/medium: exceptional art-directed contemporary 3D editorial illustration; sculpted matte porcelain and layered heavyweight paper, precise rounded edges, subtle material grain, realistic soft ambient occlusion, sophisticated restrained finish. Substantial simple shapes, crisp silhouettes and excellent small-size readability. This is a premium software brand illustration, not a stock icon or emoji.
Composition/framing: square 1024 x 1024 canvas; centered compact composition fills about 82 percent of the frame; keep all objects inside the frame with 8 percent clear margin. The browser and cursor form one coherent group. Gently front-facing, slight perspective depth, soft studio lighting from upper left.
Color palette: warm ivory surfaces, deep midnight navy #17313E for contrast, warm golden amber #E5AC45 focal accents, pale sand secondary areas. This will sit on beige cards in light and dark themes.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, clean alpha, NO opaque white rectangle, no colored background, no floor, no pedestal; only subtle contact shadows between objects, no cast background shadow.
Constraints: no letters, no words, no numbers, no readable text, no logos, no watermark. Use short simple rounded bars to imply interface content. No floating decorative spheres, no rainbow gradients, no rockets, no hands, no robot, no glassmorphism, no busy dashboard. One browser panel and one cursor only. Render beautifully with a strong clear visual hierarchy.
